description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git config' commands, including setting, getting, replacing, and unsetting configuration entries, as well as handling special characters and large numbers of entries.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a git configuration with a specific section and key.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that a specific section.key has the expected value.

methods.name: check_regex
methods.description: Verifies that a section.key matching a regex has the expected value.

methods.name: setup_many
methods.description: Sets up a git config with a large number of entries for testing.
